backward_compat_traps.rule: A nibble pulse period is 12 + value ticks (value 0-15), not the raw value.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Treating the period as the value (forgetting the 12-tick offset) decodes every nibble wrong.

backward_compat_traps.rule: The tick time is recovered from the 56-tick calibration pulse every frame.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Assuming a fixed nominal 3 us tick ignores transmitter drift (up to +/- 20%) and misdecodes nibbles.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Basic SENT is unidirectional sensor->ECU; only SENT-SPC adds an ECU trigger.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Expecting an ECU request in basic SENT is wrong.

backward_compat_traps.rule: SENT is pulse-width nibble timing on one wire with a 56-tick calibration pulse and CRC-4 nibble; LIN is UART/PID, DALI is Manchester, PWM is duty cycle.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Applying LIN PID/break, DALI Manchester, or PWM duty-cycle decoding to a SENT stream is wrong.

fields.ic_name: Single Edge Nibble Transmission (SENT, SAE J2716)
fields.spec_version: SAE J2716 — Single Edge Nibble Transmission (SENT)
previous_versions: SAE J2716 (2007) — initial SENT: single-wire nibble pulse-width sensor interface.
SAE J2716 (2010) — slow serial channel (Short/Enhanced), pause pulse, SENT-SPC variant.

key_changes.summary: Standardized the slow serial communication channel (Short Serial Message and Enhanced Serial Message), the optional pause pulse for fixed frame length, and the synchronous SENT-SPC (Short PWM Code) master-trigger variant; clarified CRC-4 and timing tolerances.

future_versions_industry_outline.summary: Continued refinement of the slow channel, CRC, and SPC addressing while preserving the tick/nibble pulse-width encoding and the message frame format.

fields.version_naming_history_note: Single Edge Nibble Transmission is standardized by SAE International as SAE J2716 (SENT). The interface preserves a single-wire pulse-width nibble encoding (12 + value ticks), a 56-tick synchronization/calibration pulse, a status nibble, 1-6 data nibbles, and a 4-bit CRC nibble across revisions; later revisions added the slow serial communication channel, the pause pulse, and the SENT-SPC (Short PWM Code) synchronous variant.
